kindNotes: modal.slice-end.record: the root has no data-frame (a container: its own border and the 8 px gap)

hud.completion-toast.data: the carter town's mill site finishing at speed 3

slot.population.records.data: the famine town's population records after it ran (QA-028: the records, not a 22 px band)

modal.year-review.data: 1302's card at 1303's first tick: its decisions (or none), the factions' moves, the town's people and money

modal.season-ledger.steward.data: a lord-mode season close with the steward's section: what he handled by which policy (each a drill-in), the money and factions, what he brought

modal.season-ledger.market.data: the market town's first season close after the proclamation (1317's autumn; lord mode: the steward's section)

hud.season-band.market.data: the market town's season close after the proclamation: the band of what changed in it (after a load: the people, the treasury, the steward's)

modal.year-review.lord.data: 1300's card on the engine's yearReview after a load (unseen): the lord's decisions, the steward's, what followed by decision, the town

hud.auto-pause.data: time run in the lord slice until the engine names a reason (the first, a great person's death): why it stopped, the ledger's line and the way on

hud.auto-pause.link.data: time run until a suit is judged: the judgment's line with the way to its suit on the ledger screen beside the way on

modal.lord.home-petition.variant-041.data: the pannage petition on the woodland in autumn in 041's words (the longest variant body)

modal.lord.home-petition.variant-048.data: the common-pasture petition in 048's words (the commons against the second merchant house)

modal.lord.home-petition.variant-056.data: the road and bridge petition beside the market in 056's words

modal.lord.registry.variant-067.data: 031's steward offer in 067's words (ability against loyalty; the longest variant title)

modal.lord.registry.variant-078.data: 019's oversight offer in 078's words (the merchant's man against the peasants')

hud.event-card.home-petition-variant.data: the pannage petition's chip card in 041's words, its card put off

hud.event-card.registry-variant.data: 031's offer's chip card in 067's words, its card put off

modal.slice-start.data: a new lord-slice game's opening page (de Haverel): the house and its arms, the home estate, the town, the neighbours, the five factions, the slice's years

modal.slice-end.data: the slice's end in 1317 (seed 3, five years after the second estate of 1312; ~/fls-slice-end-states rebuilt on the TRACE-KEEP engine): the last year 1316 at the top with its two cards as links, why and when, then and now with the maps, the decisions ranked by what followed, who remembers, a line a year with its big decisions from the thread (1300-1308 too) and what followed each, and its small matters counted in one line

modal.slice-end.record.data: the end page's first decision (1300's market dues, 67 rows followed) opened in the chronicle on its record (closing it comes back to the page)

modal.slice-end.year-card.data: 1316's year card (the last year; the slice ends in 1317 spring by its second estate) opened from the end page's link (the engine's yearReview)

modal.slice-end.season-card.data: 1316 winter's season card (the last closed before the end in 1317 spring) opened from the end page's link (it does not open by itself at the end)
